description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Diana''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them magic damage and consumes ''[[File:Diana Crescent Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Diana#Crescent Strike|An icon for Diana's ability Crescent Strike]] [[Diana#Crescent Strike|Moonlight]]'' from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, '''Diana''' will dash through their location.
description.text: Active: Diana dashes to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them magic damage and consumes Moonlight from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, Diana will dash through their location.

description2.raw: If ''Moonlight'' is consumed from the target, ''Lunar Rush's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] '''current''' cooldown is reduced to 0.25 seconds.
description2.text: If Moonlight is consumed from the target, Lunar Rush's  current cooldown is reduced to 0.25 seconds.

description3.raw: '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
description3.text: Diana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 (+ 60% AP)

notes.raw: * '''Diana''' will attempt to basic attack the target. * ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown will also be reset if the target dies during the dash while being affected by ''Moonlight''. * ''Lunar Rush'' consumes ''Moonlight'' upon ending the dash (even if [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]]). * ''Lunar Rush'' will still deal damage even if the target is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] by the end of the dash. * If ''Lunar Rush'' is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]] the ''Moonlight'' debuff is still consumed but ''Lunar Rush's'' cooldown is not reset.
notes.text:
Diana will attempt to basic attack the target.
Lunar Rush's cooldown will also be reset if the target dies during the dash while being affected by Moonlight.
Lunar Rush consumes Moonlight upon ending the dash (even if interrupted).
Lunar Rush will still deal damage even if the target is untargetable by the end of the dash.
If Lunar Rush is blocked by spell shield the Moonlight debuff is still consumed but Lunar Rush's cooldown is not reset.
